item.title: Nixa man allegedly grabs police officer's rifle during arrest
item.description: Gary Dean Hord, 63, was arrested for first-degree harassment, resisting arrest, and attempting to disarm a peace officer while performing official duty after threatening to kill a victim and refusing to comply with commands, and refusing to let go of an officer's patrol rifle.
